text: During your tour at AeroMed Laboratory in the late 50s, did you ever see anything kept in a cold storage or frozen that anyone would consider to be something from outer space, a space alien?
No, never, never to my knowledge of anything of that nature at all.
I didn't have any specimens or anything for me. The research work that was carried on was just a mess.
Not a day or a med lab. I never heard anybody talk about anything like that.
When you brought that up as part of this investigation, it was the first time I'd ever heard that.
This is also the first time anybody's spoken to you about you possibly being involved in this Roswell incident.
Yeah, I was totally surprised by that. I just had not any idea that anything like that could have been associated with the work we were doing.
Okay, if you have anything to add, that'll probably kind of wrap it up.
Nope, I don't think, I think between this and the other discussions we've had, that's pretty much it.
